# Draft:Napoleonic Wars Podcast

The Napoleonic Wars Podcast is a show dedicated to the history of the period 1775-1815. First broadcasting in March 2020, the show was initially presented by Napoleonic historian Zack White, who was later joined by Luke Reynolds and Liam Telfer.
Overview
The Napoleonic Wars Podcast initially broadcast under the name 'The Napoleonicist'. The name was changed to The Napoleonic Wars Podcast in November 2022.
As of January 2026, the show had published over 350 episodes, as is ranked within the top 1% of podcasts globally.
